description:
When spring is poured into a cup of sweet iced sakura sake; When cherry jam thickens like nectar on a midsummer night; When seafood chowder fills your mouth with autumn sea air; When molten chocolate cake melts your heart in winter snow...

With you, Valkyries can create delicious memories every day through the seasons.

(Source: Honkai Impact 3rd YouTube Channel)
